transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I'll need to hear from all four before I can sign off on the package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding from my completed RF survey. Wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop, so the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so it needs to be incorporated before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue. I received the countersigned performance license this morning, and it permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but it directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive. That archive reuse provision must be removed before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two critical talent issues from the headliner's agent that I confirmed by email but haven't yet entered into the production schedule. First, the headliner can only soundcheck at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — no other time is possible. Second, the performer's rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision that includes a sponsor product display on stage. That sponsor display provision must be removed from the stage before final approval, and the 3:00 PM soundcheck must be incorporated into the production schedule.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement. My captioning vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general control-room location specified in the current draft plan will not work. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the Booth B assignment to the lock sheet. This booth assignment must be incorporated before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
